deploy.// startCommand: Migrations run before the server, in the same release. A container that starts against an unmigrated database serves 500s that look like application bugs.
deploy.startCommand: uv run alembic upgrade head && uvicorn soyl.main:create_app --factory --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
deploy.// healthcheckPath: /live, not /health. Railway restarts a container that fails its healthcheck, so pointing it at a check that includes Postgres turns a database blip into a restart loop. /health is for humans and dashboards.
